 Advertisement Palm Beach County schools cancel after-school activities due to weather
 Advertisement Updated: 9:41 AM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs Palm Beach County schools cancel after-school activities due to weather
 Updated: 9:41 AM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Danielle Scruggs PALM BEACH COUNTY, Fla. — The School District of Palm Beach County announced that all schools and district offices are open today, Wednesday, Nov. 18, while prioritizing student and staff safety. 
 Palm Beach County School District to stay open despite flood watch "Student and staff safety is always our top priority," the district said. 
 Advertisement Due to the afternoon weather forecast, all after-school activities, athletic events, clubs, meetings, Adult Workforce and Community Education classes, and leases are canceled for the day. Aftercare services will remain open until 4 p.m., and families are required to pick up their children by that time. 
 Some Treasure Coast schools close Wednesday due to heavy rainfall concerns; Indian River, Martin open Families are encouraged to monitor bus route progress in real time using the free Here Comes the Bus app. 
 The district is actively monitoring expected weather conditions for tomorrow and will provide an update later today regarding school operations for Thursday, November 19. 
 "Thank you for your patience, partnership, and continued support of the School District of Palm Beach County," the district said.
